# Product Training

## Overview
Product training sessions focus on [customer support](./customer-support.md) roleplay, handling cross-ticket inquiries, and managing technical [troubleshooting](./troubleshooting.md) across multiple [hardware](./hardware.md) and software ecosystems, such as [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md), [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md), and competitor comparisons like [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md).

## Key Details
- **Cross-Ticket Management:** Customers may own products from different ecosystems (e.g., Nova Widget and TeaBuddy) under a single application request. Support agents must recognize that Nova utilizes the [MeshSync](./meshsync.md) garden app, while TeaBuddy uses a [BLE](./ble.md) kitchen app.
- **Competitor [Hardware Specs](./hardware-specs.md):** When customers cite competitors like SenseNode (which features an IP67 waterproof rating), agents should contrast it with our IP54 rating, recommend appropriate protective covers, and share the [product comparison](./product-comparison.md) page link.
- **Ticket #2099 (Rejoin Loop):** Identified as a known issue. The resolution is to update to [firmware](./firmware.md) version 0.3.8 and maintain a limit of six nodes.
- **TeaBuddy Pairing (iOS 18):** Connectivity and pairing issues on iOS 18 were resolved in version 0.9.3. For the TB-142 model, a long-press reset is required to bypass the cancel bug.
- **[Documentation](./documentation.md) and Typos:** Regarding customer mentions of a CR2450 battery blog typo, it has been clarified that our devices use the CR2032 battery. The internal wiki and Alex's blog have both been updated to correct this.

## Related Entities
- **Nova Widget:** Uses the MeshSync garden application.
- **TeaBuddy:** Uses a BLE kitchen application; model TB-142 subject to a cancel bug fix via long-press reset; iOS 18 pairing fixed in v0.9.3.
- **SenseNode:** Competitor product featuring an IP67 waterproof rating compared to our IP54 rating.
- **Alex:** Author/owner of the blog where technical corrections (such as battery type typos) are published.

## Related Concepts
- **[Firmware Updates](./firmware-updates.md):** Resolving known bugs like the Ticket #2099 rejoin loop (v0.3.8).
- **Customer Support Roleplay:** Training methodology used to evaluate trainee knowledge on cross-product troubleshooting.
- **[Hardware Specifications](./hardware-specifications.md):** Comparing environmental protection ratings (IP54 vs. IP67) and battery types (CR2032 vs. CR2450).
